prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Denver after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Denver for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you specific firm recommendations — but to make the list most useful I need a couple quick details first:

- How serious were your injuries (minor, moderate, severe/permanent)?  
- Do you want a large national firm or a smaller local trial boutique?  
- Any deadline (upcoming surgery, insurance deadline, statute of limitations you know of)?  

If you’d rather get names now, here’s a short, practical plan plus immediate options to call and why they’re worth contacting.

Immediate actions (call 3–5 firms)
- Call several firms so you can compare. Personal injury firms usually offer free consultations and work on contingency, so there’s no cost to talk and no obligation to hire.
- Mix types: at least one large national plaintiff firm (resources for big cases), one experienced local trial firm (hands-on, court experience), and one boutique if your case is specialized (e.g., catastrophic injury, spinal/head injury).

Two Denver firms to call now (good starting points)
- Haddon, Morgan & Foreman LLP — well-known national plaintiff personal injury firm with substantial experience in serious car-accident and catastrophic injury cases and a Denver presence. Good if your injuries are significant or you expect a big insurance fight.  
- Morgan & Morgan — large national plaintiff firm with offices across the U.S. and experience handling automobile injury claims and emergency response; useful if you want a large-team approach and quicker intake.

Where to find strong local firms
- Colorado Trial Lawyers Association (CTLA) — can point you to trial-focused plaintiff attorneys in Denver with strong trial records.  
- Denver Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service — for screened local attorneys if you want someone nearby and smaller.  
- Online ratings (Super Lawyers, Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell) — check attorney profiles, client reviews, and peer ratings.

What to look for when you call (quick checklist)
- Do you handle car-accident personal injury claims full-time? (Prefer firms that focus on plaintiff PI.)  
- Do you have experience with cases like mine and have you taken any to trial recently? (Trial experience matters if the insurer won’t settle.)  
- How do you charge? (Contingency fee percentage, any costs I’d be responsible for if we lose.)  
- Do you advance medical lien/care costs, or do I need to pay up front?  
- Who will be my primary contact—an attorney or a paralegal?  
- Typical timeline and expected next steps for a case like mine.  
- Can you give references or recent verdicts/settlements in similar cases?

What I can do next for you
- If you give the injury severity and whether you prefer big or local firms, I’ll draft a short curated list (4–6 Denver firms) with reasons to call each and a suggested order to contact them.  
- I can also draft a short script and the exact questions to ask when you call.

Which would you prefer — a curated list now (tell me small vs large firms) or do you want to answer the few questions above so I can tailor recommendations?
